title: [CQ-V08b] Strong-profile recovery landing containment
description:
Objective: close the two strong-profile landing residuals that CQ-V07 (task-16bbf8ff) and CQ-V08 (task-2720c13b) explicitly handed forward to CQ-V12. Both are wrapper-side.

Split out of the epic-final V12 by architect-e4b7eee0 on 2026-10-29. V12 is limited to the docs sweep, the whole-epic review and regression, and cannot hold wrapper edits within its size cap.

Residual 1, from V07 step 6: the next pre-flight recovery may land a REFUSED strong completion.
- V07 refuses a strong completion without a durable intent (MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_INTENT_*) and keeps the worktree bytes and baseline.
- The next pre-flight recovery (scripts/moe-agent.sh, about line 5753: LAND_KIND=checkpoint, LAND_RECOVERED=true, run_landing) can then land those bytes as a wip checkpoint on the designated target branch. That is a Git effect without intent or verification.
- The same class covers any exit or step checkpoint landing of a strong attempt.

Residual 2, from V08 step 6: a crash between record_delivery_receipt and finalize_attempt, after the journal is gone.

Deliverable: under the strong profile, ONLY a verified completion may move the designated target ref.
- Every other landing of a strong attempt's bytes keeps the target byte-identical.
- The bytes are kept: the baseline is kept, or the bytes go to a refs/moe/rescue/* ref. Never lose bytes; the 2026-08-28 lost-code path must not weaken.
- A named MOE_* code is printed.
- Strong is read from a wrapper- or daemon-written record (the pinned attempt profile, the attempt record or the receipt journal), never from an env var the CLI can set.
- For residual 2: prove it never double-lands and never finalizes a different tree. Fix it, or document the liveness residual if it is a liveness-only gap.

Scope boundaries:
- Wrapper scripts and their harnesses only: scripts/moe-agent.sh, scripts/moe-agent.ps1, scripts/tests/postflight.sh and scripts/tests/postflight.ps1.
- Legacy and observe landings stay byte-for-byte as today.
- No daemon changes. No .moe edits. No Git writes outside the wrappers' own landing code.
- Both launchers in string parity.
- Plan against V08's LANDED bytes. These files are a collision hotspot: dependsOn V08 and ad0dc2e7 serializes them.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh
definitionOfDone: Under the strong profile, a pre-flight recovery checkpoint or an exit/step checkpoint of a strong attempt leaves the designated target ref byte-identical, keeps the bytes (baseline kept or a refs/moe/rescue/* ref) and prints a named MOE_* code, proven by a new postflight.sh mode.
A crash between record_delivery_receipt and finalize_attempt of a strong landing never lands twice and never finalizes a tree other than the verified candidate's, proven by a new postflight.sh mode.
postflight.ps1 carries the same modes with identical names, fixtures and assertions (run under pwsh when available, else reported as not run), and `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` exits 0.
Legacy and observe landings are unchanged: every existing receipt-*, intent-* and reconcile-strong-* mode passes unchanged.
Fresh verification `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
scripts/tests/postflight.ps1: mirror step 4 in the embedded suite. The mode names, fixtures and assertions must be byte-identical to postflight.sh's copy, run against moe-agent.ps1. Add only the ps1-runner bits a mode needs, following the receipt-* and reconcile-strong-* modes' existing ps1 handling.

Keep the harness's structure, timeouts and BOM. Run it with `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/postflight.ps1`, and under Windows PowerShell 5.1 through interop from the repo on D: when that is reachable. If an engine is unavailable, say so; never claim it ran.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, once, as the final step. Load adversarial-self-review. Read the diff as a session trying to put unverified bytes on the target under strong. Check:
- Is there any path besides a verified completion that moves the target ref under strong: a checkpoint, a recovery, an idle recovery, a resume, or a peel onto the consolidation branch?
- Can the CLI make strong_landing_task false: an env var, a CLI-written .moe/attempts file under legacy hosting (document the threat-model limit), or a malformed newer record?
- Can a kept strong journal ever be overwritten, or deleted before finalize is acknowledged?
- Can it lead to a second landing? V08's MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_UNRECONCILED_INTENT must still refuse.
- Crashes: during the replay, between finalize and the journal delete (idempotent: the next replay finds the attempt closed and deletes it), and with two tasks landing concurrently (journals are per task).
- Liveness: a refused strong recovery repeats its [WARN] on every pre-flight until a verified completion lands the bytes. That is fail-closed by design; hand the operator-facing docs to CQ-V12 (task-b621ddc9).
- A DELIVERY_RECEIPT_CONFLICT under strong still finalizes the verified tree; note it for V12 if not.
- Legacy and observe stay byte-for-byte; parity and the BOM hold; no .moe edits; no Git writes outside the wrappers and temp test repos.
Report every path in complete_step.modifiedFiles, and write the Serena handoff memory 'task-task-7f82e200c224418896667560a49fe0ab-handoff' for CQ-V12.

comments.content:
Governor start guard (governor-4764040b, 19:01Z), for whoever claims this row once task-aa85ff13 is DONE. It applies until task-44a07f00 (the get_commit_scope fix) is live in the daemon.

aa85ff13 also edits scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1. Its QA session lands an exit checkpoint shortly after approval, and today that landing commits any change made to those files since its own pre-flight under aa85ff13's id. That is how baa704f5 swept fa7fece5's edit.

So before your FIRST edit of scripts/moe-agent.sh, scripts/moe-agent.ps1, scripts/tests/postflight.sh or scripts/tests/postflight.ps1:
1. Run `git log -5 --format=%s` and confirm a `wip(task-aa85ff13…) … [status=DONE role=qa …]` line is there.
2. If it isn't, re-check every 20 s. Read-only work is fine meanwhile.
3. If 5 minutes pass without it (for example, a dead QA seat), post one line in #governors and start anyway.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
Under the strong (verified-local) profile, only a verified completion moves the designated target ref.

Every checkpoint landing of a strong task is refused with MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_STRONG_CHECKPOINT: the post-flight exit checkpoint, the pre-flight recovery and the idle recoveries. The refusal touches no ref, index or baseline and keeps the bytes.

A strong receipt journal is kept until finalize_attempt is acknowledged, or until its attempt is found closed. A crash between the receipt and finalize is then finished by the next pre-flight replay: same tree, exactly once, never a second landing.

Legacy and observe are byte-for-byte unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: strong-checkpoint-held: refused with the code, branch byte-identical, no new rescue ref, bytes and baseline intact, record_commit refused; a CLI-visible env var claiming legacy does not change it.

strong-recovery-held: after a refused or gate-failed strong completion, the next pre-flight recovery is refused with the code, does not print MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED, and leaves the rescue ref and branch unmoved.

reconcile-strong-finalize-lost: after an accepted receipt and a lost finalize, the journal is kept; the next replay re-sends the receipt and then finalizes 'landed' once; there is exactly one completion commit.
Every existing receipt-*, intent-* and reconcile-strong-* mode passes unchanged; parity-check exits 0.
invariants: No refusal writes any ref (target or rescue), temp index or baseline; bytes are never lost.
Strong is decided only from wrapper- or daemon-written records (the pinned profile, .moe/attempts, the receipt journal), never from an env var a CLI can set.
Legacy and observe landings and journals behave exactly as today.
Journals stay per task; no new state file or journal field.
compatibility: The existing refusal codes and the MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED/MOE_RESCUE_REF lines keep their meaning for legacy and observe.
The receipt journal format is unchanged (CQ-V07/V08 fields only).
approvedScope: scripts/moe-agent.sh: new strong_landing_task and landing_refuse_strong helpers; the gate in run_landing after landing_owner_guard; the strong journal lifetime in receipt_send, finalize_postflight and receipt_replay.
scripts/moe-agent.ps1: the string-parity twins in Invoke-MoeLanding, Send-MoeReceipt, Complete-MoePostflight/Send-MoeFinalize and Invoke-MoeReceiptReplay.
scripts/tests/postflight.sh and postflight.ps1: three modes in the embedded frozen-candidate suite, byte-identical JS.
reuse: landing_refuse_owner's refusal shape in scripts/moe-agent.sh (record_commit_rpc refused plus the session summary) for landing_refuse_strong.
moe_attempt_read and moe_pinned_attempt_phase's .moe/attempts reader style in scripts/moe-agent.sh for strong_landing_task.
The embedded frozen-candidate JS suite, V07's strong fixture and V08's receipt machinery in scripts/tests/postflight.sh.
sourceAssumptions: scripts/moe-agent.sh run_landing (about line 5378) runs landing_owner_guard first (about 5401) and refuses via landing_refuse_owner (about 3472); the new gate copies that shape.

scripts/moe-agent.sh pre-flight recovery (about 5753-5768) lands a lingering baseline with LAND_KIND=checkpoint and LAND_RECOVERED=true through run_landing; the post-flight lands LAND_KIND=$LANDING_MODE (about 8596).

scripts/moe-agent.sh receipt_send (about 5215) deletes the journal on an accepted or DELIVERY_RECEIPT_CONFLICT receipt; receipt_replay (about 5318) re-sends and then finalizes 'landed' while the journaled attempt is finalizing.
packages/moe-daemon/src/state/attemptStore.ts reconcileRunningAttempts keeps a finalizing attempt's hold across restarts (it is closed only when its task is gone).

scripts/moe-agent.ps1 twins: Invoke-MoeLanding (about 4476), Get-MoeOwnerGuard (about 3137), Send-MoeReceipt (about 1707), Send-MoeFinalize (about 1749), Invoke-MoeReceiptReplay (about 1840), Complete-MoePostflight (about 5167), Read-MoeAttempt (about 1558); the recovery calls Invoke-MoeLanding -Kind 'checkpoint' (about 5018).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Residual 1:
- Chosen: ONE gate in run_landing / Invoke-MoeLanding after the owner guard, keyed on LAND_KIND checkpoint. Every checkpoint path, both recoveries and the exit checkpoint, goes through it.
- Rejected: gating each call site. That repeats the check at 3+ sites per launcher and risks missing one.
- Rejected: converting the strong checkpoint to a rescue ref. It would mint a new rescue ref on every pre-flight. V07's refusal already keeps the bytes in the worktree and the baseline, and the gate-failed rescue ref already exists.

Residual 2:
- Chosen: keep the strong journal until finalize is acknowledged. The existing replay path then finishes a lost finalize.
- Rejected: a pre-flight lookup of the daemon's receipt with finalize from it. That adds an RPC and a parse, and trusts a second source.
- Rejected: a new 'finalize owed' marker file. V08 forbids new state files.
- Rejected: changing DELIVERY_RECEIPT_CONFLICT handling. It is out of scope; the self-review checks it.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Interfaces ASSUMED from the approved plans of CQ-V07 (task-16bbf8ff) and CQ-V08 (task-2720c13b). Both are WORKING, not landed. Verify each against the landed bytes:
- PINNED_ATTEMPT_PROFILE (non-exported) and $script:PinnedAttemptProfile: pinned in pin_attempt_identity from moe_attempt_read's executionPolicySnapshot.profile, and reset with MOE_ATTEMPT_ID/GENERATION.
- The strong intent journal is written durably before update-ref, with treeSha, baseRevision, planRevision and profile. Refusal codes MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_INTENT_INCOMPLETE and _UNWRITABLE, with no ref and no rescue.
- MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_UNRECONCILED_INTENT: an existing journal refuses a strong completion before the CAS loop.
- MOE_FINALIZE_DEFERRED_RECEIPT: V08 keys 'unacknowledged' on RECEIPT_JOURNAL existing, which step 2 replaces with RECEIPT_ACKED. Also LAND_PROOF_UNTRANSFERRED and MOE_DELIVERY_PROOF_NOT_TRANSFERRED.
- receipt_journal_fields emits profile and treeSha; the replay requires L^{tree} == treeSha.
- Harness: the MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TEST_HOOK_PRE_UPDATE_REF seam, FAKE_CLAIM_MODE 'finalizing', the receipt-held crash supervisor, and the embedded frozen-candidate JS shared by postflight.sh and postflight.ps1.

scripts/CLAUDE.md documents that gate-failed bytes go to a rescue ref and are landed as a checkpoint by the next pre-flight. Under strong, that is exactly the bypass this task closes.
planningNotes.risks:
- moe-agent.sh/.ps1 are collision hotspots: build on the landed bytes, never revert peer hunks, and keep parity.
- An existing strong mode might encode journal deletion at receipt time. If so, report it; never edit it silently.
- An unreadable attempt record must be skipped, never trusted, and must not change legacy behavior.
- Threat model: under legacy hosting a host CLI could write .moe/attempts. The strong guarantee assumes verified-local isolation (the CLI is in the guest); document this, do not over-claim.
- A refused recovery repeats every pre-flight. That is by design, and the docs go to CQ-V12.
- PowerShell 5.1 BOM and quoting; pwsh may be unavailable, so say so and never claim it ran.
- postflight.sh is slow: widen the timeout rather than skipping modes.
